title: dactylorhiza incarnata subsp. dufftii
intro: Dactylorhiza incarnata subsp. dufftii, commonly known as the Himalayan orchid or Dufft's marsh orchid, is a type of orchid plant native to the Himalayan region. This plant is traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to reduce inflammation and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza incarnata subsp. dufftii include acting as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic, helping to treat conditions such as urinary tract infections and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
